method: Whole original no-renames patch read; exact public peer registry input/sanitizer/promotion/sink methods and private TT helper read from authenticated pinned npm archives. No installed helper imported into owned code.
source_observations: The specific upstream change relocates the policy helper and rewires registry import/build/API exposure; it does not add sanitizer validation to the helper.

Both exact peer registries sanitize literal input with SecurityContext.HTML and configured URLs with SecurityContext.RESOURCE_URL. Downloaded SVG text is promoted before the innerHTML sink; resource trust is not sanitization of downloaded contents.
The TT policy createHTML callback returns its input. Do not treat TT promotion as XSS sanitization or a trust grant for arbitrary network SVG.
The 21.2.14 TT policy creation propagates an exception; 22.1.7 catches/logs that exception and falls back. The reviewed relocation alone does not certify that later fallback change.
probe_scope: Actual public registry/sanitizer plus peer MatIcon rendered inside packed legacy button in the packed-consumer DOM harness: fixed trusted SVG, raw-script rejection, independent clones. This is the TT-unavailable fallback route, not browser require-trusted-types-for enforcement, allowed-policy rejection or network SVG qualification.
